introduction: Pennsylvania SNAP provides grocery assistance to eligible households. DHS encourages people to apply even when they are unsure about eligibility.
description: Pennsylvania SNAP provides grocery assistance to eligible households. DHS encourages people to apply even when they are unsure about eligibility.

sections.who: Income, household size, disability and applicable work rules affect eligibility. DHS reviews the application rather than requiring you to decide in advance.
sections.get: Approved benefits help pay for eligible food. The agency determines the amount from the household’s circumstances.
sections.docs:
• Identity and household information.
  • Income and relevant expense records.
  • Any additional verification the county requests.
sections.apply:
1. Submit a request

    Apply through COMPASS, or mail or deliver a paper application to your county assistance office.

  2. Complete follow-up

    Attend the requested interview and provide the document checklist. Explain any urgent lack of food.

  3. Track the case

    Check Track My Benefits and read the notice.
sections.after: Follow reporting, work-rule and renewal instructions for your case. Keep submission records and ask the county to explain any unclear requirement.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Pennsylvania SNAP application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Must I know I qualify first?
No. DHS encourages an application for a decision.
Can someone apply on my behalf?
A designated authorized representative can apply.
Is online intake the only option?
Paper applications can be mailed or delivered to the county office.
The state provides Track My Benefits.
